criteria.name: terminal_bell_at_hitl_gates
criteria.description: All HITL gates (spec approval, contract approval, and any interactive prompts) write the terminal bell character (\x07) to stdout immediately before or alongside the prompt text

criteria.name: terminal_bell_on_fatal_error
criteria.description: When the harness encounters a fatal error that halts execution, a terminal bell character (\x07) is emitted alongside the error output

criteria.name: notify_flag_parsed
criteria.description: The CLI accepts a --notify flag. When provided, the resolved config includes a notify: true property. When omitted, it defaults to false

criteria.name: desktop_notification_with_notify_flag
criteria.description: When --notify is enabled and a HITL gate or fatal error occurs, the harness invokes the platform-appropriate desktop notification command (notify-send on Linux, osascript on macOS) with a descriptive message

criteria.name: no_desktop_notification_without_flag
criteria.description: When --notify is not provided, no desktop notification subprocess is spawned at HITL gates or errors — only the terminal bell is emitted

criteria.name: commit_adhd_flag_parsed
criteria.description: The CLI accepts --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs flags. They are correctly parsed into the resolved config object with appropriate boolean properties

criteria.name: commit_adhd_creates_metadata_commit
criteria.description: When --commit-adhd is enabled and a sprint passes evaluation, a git commit is created containing .adhd/contracts/, .adhd/feedback/, .adhd/progress.json, and .adhd/spec.md with the message format '[adhd] Sprint N: contract + metadata'

criteria.name: commit_adhd_logs_includes_logs
criteria.description: When --commit-adhd-logs is enabled, the metadata commit additionally includes files from .adhd/logs/

criteria.name: commit_adhd_logs_implies_commit_adhd
criteria.description: When --commit-adhd-logs is provided without --commit-adhd, the resolved config sets commitAdhd to true (implication logic)

criteria.name: default_no_adhd_commits
criteria.description: When neither --commit-adhd nor --commit-adhd-logs is provided, no [adhd] metadata commits are created after sprints complete

criteria.name: notification_helper_is_reusable
criteria.description: Notification logic (bell + optional desktop notification) is encapsulated in a single reusable function or module (e.g., notify() or a Notifier class) called from all HITL gates and error handlers, rather than duplicated inline at each call site

criteria.name: platform_detection_is_clean
criteria.description: Platform detection for desktop notifications uses process.platform or equivalent, handles at least 'linux' and 'darwin', and gracefully no-ops on unsupported platforms without throwing. The notification subprocess failure (e.g., notify-send not installed) is caught and logged as a warning, not a fatal error

criteria.name: commit_function_follows_existing_git_patterns
criteria.description: The function that creates [adhd] metadata commits reuses existing git helper utilities in the codebase (e.g., existing exec/spawn wrappers for git commands) rather than introducing a parallel git invocation pattern. Variable and function names are descriptive (e.g., commitAdhdArtifacts, not commitStuff)

criteria.name: app_starts_and_parses_new_flags
criteria.description: The harness entry point starts cleanly with the new flags (--notify, --commit-adhd, --commit-adhd-logs) without runtime errors, and --help output documents the new options
